description: Create a brand-new multi-platform campaign draft with tailored assets across social, WordPress, Webflow, Ghost, Shopify Blog, Custom Webhook, and Hosted Blog channels (returning contentId and per-channel assetIds), with optional immediate publishing or Client Review Link. Always share viewUrl after saving and offer follow-up updates in place via wordflux_update_content(contentId).

base64Images.description: Optional Base64 or Data URI images for this asset

content.description: Full post or article body copy tailored for this platform (Markdown or HTML supported for blog/CMS; optional when threadPosts is provided)

documentTitle.description: Optional LinkedIn PDF carousel document title

documentUrl.description: Optional HTTPS PDF URL for native swipeable LinkedIn Document Carousels

imageUrl.description: Optional single HTTPS image URL for this asset

imageUrls.description: Optional HTTPS image URLs for this asset

metaDescription.description: Optional SEO meta description / excerpt for CMS or Hosted Blog

openaiFileIdRefs.description: Optional ChatGPT user-uploaded or AI-generated image file references (openaiFileIdRefs) for this asset

pageId.description: Optional destination pageId or CMS collectionId

platform.description: Platform for this asset (linkedin, instagram, threads, google-business, facebook, x, pinterest, bluesky, mastodon, youtube, tiktok, blog, article, wordpress, webflow, ghost, shopify, webhook)

slug.description: Optional custom URL slug for Hosted Blog or CMS

svgImages.description: Optional SVG XML strings or data:image/svg+xml Data URIs to rasterize into crisp PNGs for this asset

tags.description: Optional SEO tags for CMS or Hosted Blog

threadPosts.description: Optional ordered array of multi-post thread items for X/Twitter, Threads, Bluesky, or Mastodon

title.description: Optional asset title (Pinterest, YouTube, WordPress, Webflow, Ghost, Shopify, Webhook, Hosted Blog)

videoUrl.description: Optional HTTPS MP4/MOV video URL for video social channels

createReviewLink.description: Optional: set true to generate a shareable no-login Client Review URL (/review/:token)

openaiFileIdRefs.description: Array of user-uploaded or AI-generated image files from ChatGPT to persist across campaign assets

svgImages.description: Optional SVG XML strings or data:image/svg+xml Data URIs to rasterize into PNGs across assets

name: wordflux_create_campaign
